ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher under NS-7; no account flag against the driver.

rejected_claims.reason: The 5 min 50 s acceptance-to-cancellation gap (F4) and the 14:12:20 arrival record (F5) do not satisfy NS-1, which measures waiting at the pickup point after the arrival indication, not elapsed time since acceptance; the record shows only 2 min 30 s within 200 m and 1 min 40 s after the 14:13:10 tap (F2, F6, F3) [NS-1].

Accepted only in part: F2/F1 do establish NS-1(ii), but they also fix the cumulative within-200 m time at 2 min 30 s, below the >3 minutes (≥3:01) NS-1(iii) requires, so the element cannot carry the fee [F2][F1][F6][NS-1].

Correctly identifies F10 and F12 as party statements, but the concession defeats the driver's own case: with the system records (F2, F3, F6) controlling, NS-1(iii) fails and NS-2 mandates the refund [F10][F12][F2][F3][F6][NS-1][NS-2].

The profile facts (571 trips, 4.58 rating, 0 upheld disputes) are not a route to no_action; under NS-2 the fee must be refunded once NS-1(iii) fails, and profile facts cannot decide the case [F17][NS-2].
The driver's own concession is consistent with the outcome sought by the rider; it is not a basis for upholding the fee, since NS-1 requires all three elements cumulatively [F2][F3][F5][F6][NS-1].
Traffic and weather facts (F13–F15) are not part of the NS-1 test and were not relied on; the refund rests solely on the unmet waiting-time element [F13][F14][F15][NS-1].
No flag_account is sought or granted; NS-2's supplementary flag requires a tap made while outside the pickup radius, and F6/F1 show the 14:13:10 tap was made 39 m from the pickup [F6][F1][NS-2].
